newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session a shade lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session a shade lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.20 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 445.38 points, down from 446.26 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 312,084 dinars against 754,799 dinars over the previous session.
Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis fell 1.78 dinar to 76.2 dinars with only 62 shares changing hands.
Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.37 dinar to 18.64 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air eased 0.32 dinar to 19.16 dinars with the exchange of 2,979 shares.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF rose 0.2 dinar to 13.8 dinars.
Most of the trade was on Banque Nationale de Developpement Touristique with 14,600 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 7.94 dinars.
